title: Text padding and reliable opacity
summary: Inset text within its box, adjust text opacity in Advanced, and keep saved colors stable while browsing properties.

Added: Plain-text padding in Advanced, from 0 to 128 image pixels. Wrapping, alignment and clipping use the inset area while the editable box retains its size.
An explicit text-opacity percentage control for selected text and callout text. Edits preserve RGB and round alpha to the project's 8-bit channel.
Fixed: Viewing translucent colors no longer lets color-picker conversions alter saved RGBA values. Text properties, callout fill/outline, text drafts and New Image share the correction.
Fully transparent text retains its saved color so raising opacity can reveal it again. The opacity control fits the compact properties pane.
Improved: Legacy text projects default to zero padding and retain their pixels. Native padding Undo/Redo and exact clipboard rendering are verified.
The detailed UI audit now includes the maximized Text panel and explicitly tracks missing rich styles, outline/shadow, installed fonts and exact numeric color entry.

limitations: Screen capture, global hotkeys and full reference-interface parity remain unfinished.
Text opacity affects callout text only; fill and outline keep their own alpha values. Rich styles, installed fonts, outlines/shadows and inline text entry remain pending.
Actual color-picker edits may still round numeric channels. Exact numeric RGBA entry is tracked separately.
Reference control presence is observed; its precise ranges, defaults and rendering behavior have not all been compared.
Native Save As/export-dialog inspection remains blocked; existing-path saves, shared PNG export and native clipboard comparisons provide the verified scope.
